// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-GROUP-KEY
// A key list behind a constant is a key list nobody reviews, and one import
// away it is a key list nobody can even read.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

const KEYS = ["classId"];

export async function pupilsPerClass() {
  return db.student.groupBy({ by: KEYS, _count: true });
}
